+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = r'''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.10"
+author: Ruckus Wireless (@Commscope)
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Manage syslog destinations and logging settings on ICX switches.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or setting to manage.
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, facility, on]
+    type: str
+  name:
+    description: Hostname or address for a host destination.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a host destination.
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility name.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Buffered severity level or console level.
+    type: raw
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings to reconcile together.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  state:
+    description: Whether the setting should be present.
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+    type: str
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Read running configuration; defaults to the environment setting.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Add IPv6 syslog server
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: host
+    name: 2001:db8::1
+    udp_port: 514
+- name: Configure several settings
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: facility, facility: local7}
+      - {dest: host, name: 192.0.2.4, udp_port: 1514}
+      - {dest: buffered, level: [warnings, errors]}
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the device.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+'''
+
+import re
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+LEVELS = ('alerts', 'critical', 'debugging', 'emergencies', 'errors', 'informational', 'notifications', 'warnings')
+DESTINATIONS = ('host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'facility', 'on')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    names = param if param is not None else check.keys()
+    return sum(1 for name in names if check.get(name) is not None)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    """Validate a destination's required arguments."""
+    for rule in spec or []:
+        key, value, required = rule[:3]
+        if module.params.get(key) == value:
+            missing = [name for name in required if module.params.get(name) is None]
+            if missing:
+                module.fail_json(msg="%s is required when %s is %s" % (', '.join(missing), key, value))
+    for entry in param or []:
+        dest = entry.get('dest')
+        if dest == 'host' and not entry.get('name'):
+            module.fail_json(msg='name is required when dest is host')
+        if dest == 'buffered' and entry.get('level') is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='level is required when dest is buffered')
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    params = module.params
+    entries = params.get('aggregate') or [{k: params.get(k) for k in ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level')}]
+    check_required_if(module, required_if, entries)
+    result = []
+    for item in entries:
+        dest = item.get('dest')
+        if dest not in DESTINATIONS:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest must be one of %s' % ', '.join(DESTINATIONS))
+        obj = {'dest': dest, 'state': params.get('state', 'present'), 'name': None,
+               'udp_port': None, 'facility': None, 'level': None, 'addr6': False}
+        if dest == 'host':
+            obj['name'] = item.get('name')
+            obj['udp_port'] = str(item['udp_port']) if item.get('udp_port') is not None else None
+            obj['addr6'] = bool(validate_ip_v6_address(obj['name']))
+        elif dest == 'facility':
+            obj['facility'] = item.get('facility')
+            if obj['facility'] is None:
+                module.fail_json(msg='facility is required when dest is facility')
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            level = item.get('level')
+            obj['level'] = set(level if isinstance(level, (list, tuple, set)) else [level])
+            invalid = obj['level'] - set(LEVELS)
+            if invalid:
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid buffered level: %s' % ', '.join(sorted(invalid)))
+        else:
+            obj['level'] = item.get('level')
+        result.append(obj)
+    return result
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line) if dest == 'host' else None
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest != 'host':
+        return None
+    match = re.search(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+(?:ipv6\s+)?(\S+)', line)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return bool(dest == 'host' and re.search(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+ipv6\s+', line))
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, compare=module.params.get('check_running_config')) or ''
+    lines = config.splitlines()
+    result = []
+    for line in lines:
+        name = parse_name(line, 'host')
+        if name:
+            result.append({'dest': 'host', 'name': name, 'addr6': parse_address(line, 'host'),
+                           'udp_port': parse_port(line, 'host'), 'facility': None, 'level': None,
+                           'state': 'present'})
+        match = re.match(r'\s*logging facility\s+(\S+)', line)
+        if match:
+            result.append({'dest': 'facility', 'facility': match.group(1), 'state': 'present'})
+    if not any(x.get('dest') == 'facility' for x in result):
+        result.append({'dest': 'facility', 'facility': 'user', 'state': 'present'})
+    if 'no logging on' not in lines:
+        result.append({'dest': 'on', 'state': 'present'})
+    simple = {'console': r'^\s*logging console(?:\s+(\S+))?',
+              'persistence': r'^\s*logging persistence\b',
+              'rfc5424': r'^\s*logging enable rfc5424\b'}
+    for dest, pattern in simple.items():
+        if any(re.match(pattern, line) for line in lines):
+            result.append({'dest': dest, 'state': 'present'})
+    buffered = set()
+    for line in lines:
+        positive = re.match(r'\s*logging buffered\s+(\S+)', line)
+        negative = re.match(r'\s*no logging buffered\s+(\S+)', line)
+        if positive and positive.group(1) in LEVELS:
+            buffered.add(positive.group(1))
+        elif negative and negative.group(1) in LEVELS:
+            buffered.discard(negative.group(1))
+    result.append({'dest': 'buffered', 'level': buffered, 'state': 'present'})
+    return result
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    return next((obj for obj in lst if obj.get('name') == name), None)
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    wanted, current = set(want.get('level') or ()), set(have.get('level') or ())
+    return wanted - current, current - wanted
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for obj in want:
+        dest, state = obj['dest'], obj['state']
+        positive = state == 'present'
+        if dest == 'host':
+            old = search_obj_in_list(obj['name'], have)
+            prefix = 'ipv6 ' if obj.get('addr6') else ''
+            if positive and (old is None or (obj.get('udp_port') and old.get('udp_port') != obj.get('udp_port'))):
+                if old is not None:
+                    old_prefix = 'ipv6 ' if old.get('addr6') else ''
+                    old_cmd = 'no logging host %s%s' % (old_prefix, obj['name'])
+                    if old.get('udp_port'):
+                        old_cmd += ' udp-port %s' % old['udp_port']
+                    commands.append(old_cmd)
+                cmd = 'logging host %s%s' % (prefix, obj['name'])
+                if obj.get('udp_port'):
+                    cmd += ' udp-port %s' % obj['udp_port']
+                commands.append(cmd)
+            elif not positive and old is not None:
+                old_prefix = 'ipv6 ' if old.get('addr6') else ''
+                cmd = 'no logging host %s%s' % (old_prefix, obj['name'])
+                port = obj.get('udp_port') or old.get('udp_port')
+                if port:
+                    cmd += ' udp-port %s' % port
+                commands.append(cmd)
+        elif dest == 'facility':
+            current = next((x.get('facility') for x in have if x.get('dest') == dest), 'user')
+            if positive and obj.get('facility') != current:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % obj['facility'])
+            elif not positive and obj.get('facility') == current and current != 'user':
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = next((x for x in have if x.get('dest') == dest), {'level': set()})
+            if positive:
+                adds, removes = diff_in_list(obj, current)
+            else:
+                adds, removes = set(), set(obj.get('level') or ()) & set(current.get('level') or ())
+            commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % x for x in sorted(adds))
+            commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % x for x in sorted(removes))
+        elif dest == 'on':
+            present = any(x.get('dest') == 'on' for x in have)
+            if positive and not present:
+                commands.append('logging on')
+            elif not positive and present:
+                commands.append('no logging on')
+        else:
+            forms = {'console': ('logging console', 'no logging console'),
+                     'persistence': ('logging persistence', 'no logging persistence'),
+                     'rfc5424': ('logging enable rfc5424', 'no logging enable rfc5424')}
+            add, remove = forms[dest]
+            present = any(x.get('dest') == dest for x in have)
+            if positive and not present:
+                commands.append(add)
+            elif not positive and present:
+                commands.append(remove)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    spec = dict(dest=dict(choices=DESTINATIONS), name=dict(), udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+                facility=dict(), level=dict(), aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict'),
+                state=dict(default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']),
+                check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                          fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    entries = map_params_to_obj(module, [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])])
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((entries, have))
+    result = {'changed': bool(commands), 'commands': commands}
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
